title: feat(spec): a select option declares its lifecycle kind (open / won / lost); every stage-field option must declare it
body:
Fixes #23809
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

## What

A select option declares its lifecycle `kind`, one closed vocabulary for every object: `open` (a step on the way), `won` (the successful end), `lost` (the unsuccessful end). Every option of the field an object's `stageField` names must declare it.

- `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`: `SelectOptionSchema` gains `kind: z.enum(['open', 'won', 'lost']).optional()`, documented with the definition (a task's Done and a case's Resolved are `won`; Cancelled / Unqualified / Closed Lost are `lost`). Absent stays absent at parse (reads as `open`; no default is written in). `FieldSchema` refuses `kind` at `options.N.kind` on any field that is not a single-value `select` / `radio`. Exported type `SelectOptionKind`. The `dueLike` / `settledWhen` docblock now says options carry a `kind` but overdue is still judged by `settledWhen` alone (objectui#11815 ruling D unchanged; nothing is wired).
- `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`: `refuseStageFieldWithoutKinds`, an `ObjectSchema` parse-time check beside `refuseDishonestReferenceDeletedWhen`. One located issue per option without `kind` at `fields.FIELD.options.N.kind`, message naming the field and the option. Also refused at `stageField`: a picklist-backed stage field, and a stage field that has options but holds no single option code per record (`multiselect`, `multiple: true`). Left as they were: `stageField: false`, a pointer to no declared field (lint `semantic-roles` owns it), a field with no options.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`: `FormSelectOptionSchema` is derived from the option shape, so it now leaves out `kind` as well as `default`, with a guidance line pointing at the object field. Without that, `kind` would have been accepted on form-view options with nothing reading it.
- Forms: the object designer's options repeater offers `kind` (a select of the three values); the field form's repeater lists it. The platform-objects metadata-form bundles carry the new row, translated into zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES.
- Liveness: `field/options` is now **drilled**. Six children are `live` with their read points, and `kind` is `planned` (no `authorWarn`, because the key is mandatory under `stageField`). The `field/options` row leaves `undrilled-containers.baseline.json`. `picklist/options.kind` is `planned`.
- ADR-0087: the D3 entry `stage-field-option-kind-required`. It has no conversion because the ruling withholds a default.
- `examples/app-showcase/.../semantic-zoo.object.ts`: the only `stageField: 'status'` in the corpus now declares `open` / `open` / `won`.
- Changeset `.changeset/23809-select-option-kind.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor, `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, with the migration.

## Vocabulary ruling: premise reading

The seat ruled `open | won | lost` on the premise that `record:path` `stages[].terminal: z.enum(['won', 'lost'])` is a live platform vocabulary. Measured at objectui `main` @63d00da: `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-path.tsx` declares `PathStage.terminal?: 'won' | 'lost'`, and its `classify` returns `s.terminal` first (line 221), ahead of the token heuristic. The premise holds. `component.zod.ts` is untouched.

## Acceptance pins (`packages/spec/src/data/select-option-kind.test.ts`)

1. An option with a terminal kind parses: `an option with a terminal kind parses, and keeps it`.
2. An unknown kind is refused: `an unknown kind is refused at the option, located` (`done`, `cancelled`, `closed`, `WON`, empty).
3. A plain select without kinds parses and reads as open: `a plain select without kinds parses, and an absent kind stays absent (reads as open)`.
4. A stage field with one option lacking `kind` is refused, naming the field and option: `one option lacking kind is refused at publish, naming the field and the option` (path `fields.status.options.3.kind`), plus `each option lacking kind is its own located issue`, `create() refuses the same object`.
5. `kind` on a non-select field is refused: `is refused on a \`%s\` field` over multiselect, checkboxes, tags, `multiple: true` select/radio, lookup, text.

Updated pins: `field-rows-option-description.test.ts` (the repeater's input list gains `kind`), `form-select-option.test.ts` (Omit minus `default` and `kind`; the `kind` refusal names the object field).

## Verification (head 4274c652, plus the final typecheck)

- `@objectstack/spec` full vitest: 21996 passed, 2 failed. Both failures were the two pins above, updated afterwards. The re-run of those files, the new file and `src/migrations`: 279/279. `pnpm typecheck` exit 0. `check:generated`: all 14 artifacts up to date.
- **Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation proved on disk, restored blob == HEAD with an empty `git diff HEAD`): deleting the `refuseStageFieldWithoutKinds(...)` call turns 6 stage pins red. Turning the `FieldSchema` off-type guard into `if (false)` turns 7 off-type pins red. Both are green again after restore.
- Downstream: rest FLS / save-gate suites 125/125, runtime `meta-object-fls` 85/85, metadata-core `object-schema-fls-references` 53/53. Showcase `validate`, `build` and `typecheck` all exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 116 families derived, 116 run. All exit 0 except: `check:i18n` exit 1, a real finding (bundles drifted), fixed by regenerating and translating, now 0. `check:skill-examples`, `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-coverage` re-run green after a dist rebuild. Two families are **NOT MEASURED** locally, exit 3 (prerequisite): `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (the shallow clone cannot reach its pinned fixture) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (needs the whole workspace built). Both are left to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- **Picklist-backed stage field**: refused at `stageField` rather than judged, because `ObjectSchema` cannot see a picklist's options. Zero instances in the corpus. The alternative, judging the resolved list where `os validate` resolves picklist references, would cover only the CLI doors and not the save door. This is recorded in the report's open questions.
- The object designer's options repeater is shown for `multiselect` / `checkboxes` too, and the form DSL has no parent-scoped row predicate. So `kind` is offered there and the publish door refuses it. The help text says "single-value select / radio only".
- `FLS_CONTRACT_OBJECT` (metadata-core testing fixture) names `stageField: 'salary_grade'` over kind-less options. No door parses it in its suites (all green), so it is left as it is.
- Readers follow in their own cards: the objectui record path / kanban, the Studio inspector column, and the HotCRM declarations.
